title: President Rinkēvičs packs his bags for lengthy trip to America
summary_full: President Edgars Rinkēvičs will pay a working visit to the United States from September 17th to 28th to participate in the opening of the 81st session of the UN General Assembly in New York and the 75th anniversary congress of the Latvian Association of America in Washington.
